{"metadata":{"description":"Mixture of Agents (MoA) plugin for DeepSeek Harness with /moa slash command, file workspaces, and Live Canvas integration","id":"gh:1357256243","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-moa","slug":"GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-moa","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","mixture-of-agents","moa"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Mixture of Agents (MoA) plugin for DeepSeek Harness with /moa slash command, file workspaces, and Li"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ve Canvas integration"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-moa"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Mixture of Agents (MoA) Multi-Model Collaboration & Synthesis Engine for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"🇬🇧 English •
🇷🇺 Русский •
🇨🇳 中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"nd motivates me to keep developing it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview & The Problem"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Single-model AI generation often suffers from blind spots, single-perspective biases, hallucinated a"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"rchitectural choices, and inconsistent code quality on challenging engineering tasks. When prompted "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"with ambiguous or complex specifications, a single model may make premature assumptions and produce "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"monolithic, unvetted implementations."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**`@goodandready/dsh-moa`** brings the **Mixture of Agents (MoA)** architecture natively to DeepSeek"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" Harness via the `/moa` slash command:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"1. **Adaptive Clarification Questionnaire**: For broad or underspecified prompts, advisor models for"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"mulate clarifying options and the judge synthesizes a structured 2–4 question questionnaire before g"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"enerating code.
2. **Parallel Proposers Fan-Out & Workspace Isolation**: Multiple independent models"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" evaluate the prompt concurrently. Each candidate's proposed files are written to isolated disk sand"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"boxes (`.moa/candidate-N/`), avoiding cross-pollution.
3. **Frontier Judge Evaluation & File Promoti"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"on**: A flagship reasoning model critically benchmarks all proposals, selects the winning candidate "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"via machine markers (`WINNER_CANDIDATE_INDEX: N`), and promotes the winner's files directly into the"},{"id":"p10s8","text":" project root directory.
4. **Token-Saving Chat Summarization**: Replaces massive code dumps in chat"},{"id":"p10s9","text":" bubbles with compact file listings and clean architectural summaries.
5. **One-Shot Session Model R"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"estoration**: Executes cleanly as a one-shot turn modifier, automatically reverting back to the user"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"'s primary session model immediately after completion.
6. **Dynamic Model Pricing Catalog & Token Es"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"timation**: Real-time rate resolution for 300+ models fetched automatically in the background from O"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"penRouter's public catalog (cached locally in `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-moa-catalog.json` for 24h), plus "},{"id":"p10s14","text":"support for direct vendor rates and custom `prices` overrides in `settings.yaml`.
7. **Refinement Mo"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"de (Incremental Edits)**: Automatically detects existing codebase context to generate precise delta "},{"id":"p10s16","text":"modifications instead of destructive full-file rewrites.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## 🏗️ Architecture"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## ✨ Features & Capabilities"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 1. Slash Command (`/moa`) & Autocompletion
Integrated directly into the DeepSeek Harness compose"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"r via client input triggers. Typing `/moa` shows presets and instant autocompletion:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Or target a specific named preset:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The flag form is equivalent:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Or promote a candidate solution directly (by candidate index or runId + candidate index):"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### 2. Adaptive Questionnaire Gate
When prompts are open-ended or lack architectural specifications "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"(e.g. *"build a calculator app"*), advisor models detect ambiguities and formulate focused clarifyin"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"g questions (e.g., UI style, persistence backend, framework choice) before generating code."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### 3. Parallel Fan-Out with Live Heartbeats
* Proposers query concurrently with live heartbeat prog"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ress badges (`⏳ [3s] Processing...`, per-model completion status).
* Bulky system prompts and tool s"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"chemas are cleanly stripped from advisor contexts, eliminating "missing tools" refusals and token bl"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"as are cleanly stripped from advisor contexts, eliminating "missing tools" refusals and token bloat."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### 4. Disk-Level Candidate Isolation & Promotion
Unlike standard chat-only MoA, `dsh-moa` isolates "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"file generation onto the filesystem:
* Each proposer generates files into `.moa/candidate-1/`, `.moa"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"/candidate-2/`, etc.
* The Judge compares implementations and selects the optimal solution with `WIN"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"NER_CANDIDATE_INDEX: N`.
* The winner's files are promoted to the workspace root, and temporary cand"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"idate directories are pruned automatically."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### 5. Native Settings Card & Presets
Configure your models in `Settings → Plugins → Mixture of Agen"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ts`:
* Set custom Proposer models (e.g., fast generative models for diverse ideas).
* Set the Aggreg"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ator / Judge model (e.g., deep reasoning models for rigorous critique).
* Configure named presets (`"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"default`, `fast`, `deep-reasoning`), judge criteria and temperatures.
* Enable or disable MoA and se"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"e the real host status chip; the telemetry grid shows total runs and average run cost."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### 7. Candidate Diff Viewer
Inspect line-by-line differences between candidate proposals and the cu"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"rator's synthesized deliverable directly in the UI. Features file selection, delta line highlights ("},{"id":"p26s3","text":"added, removed, same), and unified diff rendering via a zero-dependency in-memory LCS algorithm."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### 8. Pre-Promotion Git Checkpoints (`dsh-time-machine`)
Before promoting any winning candidate fil"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"es over the workspace root, `dsh-moa` invokes the local `dsh-time-machine` service to create a shado"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"w Git checkpoint (`moa-pre-promotion: candidate-N`). If `dsh-time-machine` is absent or unreachable,"},{"id":"p27s4","text":" file promotion is blocked (fail-closed) to protect uncheckpointed workspace files against unintende"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"d overwrites (override with `force: true` only when automated checkpoints are explicitly unneeded)."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### 9. Automated Test Execution Gate
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### 10. Multi-Judge Panel & Consensus Voting
When `multi_judge_enabled: true`, candidate solutions a"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"re independently evaluated by a panel of judge models. Winner selection supports `majority`, `highes"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"t_score`, or `unanimous` consensus strategies."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### 11. Composite Hybrid Synthesis (AST / Block Merge)
When `composite_merge_enabled: true`, the agg"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"regator assembles a modular hybrid: combining the strongest core logic from one model, robust error "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"handling from another, and complete types/tests from a third."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### 12. Smart Dynamic Preset Router & LLM Classifier
When invoking `/moa` without explicit preset fl"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ags, the router classifies prompt intent using keyword heuristics or a zero-shot router model (`smar"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"t_routing_model`) to automatically select the optimal preset."}],"truncated":true}
